A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same Concept2Concept research, with complete, readable main text and appendices. Figures, tables, equations, and relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V2 reports original image-generation experiments, bias-probing reproductions, disability analyses, and audits of Pick-a-Pic and StableImageNet in Sections 4–5 and the appendices.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results and adds a five-detector comparison in Appendix A.6.

M1.justification: The sampling, concept extraction/localization, frequency, stability, co-occurrence, and prompt-revision procedures are retained. The new ablation varies the detector within the framework's existing configurable design.

E1.justification: The age/action, profession, disability, Pick-a-Pic, and StableImageNet coverage is retained, including the existing cross-model examples. The detector ablation uses the existing toy setting; the new guidance table introduces no evaluated task.

E2.justification: Appendix A.6 adds GroundingDINO, Kosmos-2, OWLv2, and DETR as detector-level comparators alongside Florence-2. The StableBias and TBYB comparator membership in Table 1 remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The new detector comparison measures concept frequencies and unique-concept counts against parameter counts on the toy setting, reported as roughly 3,000 images. GroundingDINO and OWLv2 receive BLIP-generated captions. Existing case-study settings remain unchanged; this does not establish an increased original sample size.

E4.justification: Appendix A.6 and Figures 8–9 add a focused detector-choice sensitivity analysis examining concept coverage and model-size tradeoffs. Existing stability, cross-model, prompt-revision, and dataset case studies are largely retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report ten random samples of 1,000 Pick-a-Pic entries and confidence intervals. No repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty-estimation practices, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Figures 8–9 add detector-specific frequencies and unique-concept counts; for example, Figure 8 reports face frequencies of 90.33% for Florence-2 and 1.30% for Kosmos-2. Table 1 and the toy-example bar values are unchanged. Figure 6 also revises several age-specific nudity and hypersexualization annotations.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions of sampling, concept distributions, frequency, co-occurrence, and stability are unchanged. The stability definition moves from Section 3 to Appendix A.1 and is renumbered; no substantive theoretical additions appear.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: interpretable concept-association auditing, the Pick-a-Pic and StableImageNet findings, and an open-source interactive tool.

C2.justification: V3 explicitly limits the framework's ability to capture artistic styles, distinguishes nudity from disproportionate demographic hypersexualization, and adds interpretations of detector suitability and efficiency in Appendices A.3–A.6.

D1.justification: V3 documents BLIP-caption preprocessing for the new detector comparison. Section 5.1 newly reports that Pick-a-Pic was taken offline after disclosure to its authors, although the appendix retains its access URL. Existing hyperparameter tables and tool-access information are retained.

R1.justification: V3 adds references for DETR, GroundingDINO, OWLv2, and Kosmos-2 and discusses their suitability. The synthetic-data related-work passage moves to Appendix A.5; the principal positioning against prior auditing frameworks remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V3 adds guidance and explanatory passages, reorganizes the appendix, and moves stability and synthetic-data related work out of the main text. Journal headers and localized wording edits accompany an otherwise largely retained narrative.

P2.justification: V3 adds Table 2 and Figures 8–9, promotes the overview from v2 Figure 7 to Figure 1, changes chart labels, arranges disability panels horizontally, and fully redacts the Pick-a-Pic example images. Most existing appendix displays are retained.

improvement.justification: The detector-sensitivity experiment, practical guidance, and more specific applicability and ethical qualifications provide modest validation and clarity gains over v2. These gains remain limited: concept counts do not establish detection accuracy, and Figure 9 contradicts the new assertion that Florence-2 has the smallest model size.
